items.title: 18.7.1 Copper(II) complexes ke ligand exchange reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.7.1 with Figures 18.7 and 18.8, printed page 25.

blocks.text: Jab hum Cu²⁺(aq) likhte hain to asal mein complex ion [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ murad hota hai. Yahi ion copper(II) salt, maslan copper sulphate, ke solution ko neela (blue) rang deta hai. Copper(II) solution mein sodium hydroxide dalne se halka neela precipitate banta hai; is reaction mein do paani ke ligands ki jagah do hydroxide ions aa jate hain.
Agar concentrated ammonia solution dala jaye to halka neela precipitate ghul jata hai aur gehra neela (dark blue) solution banta hai.
[Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺(aq) ki banawat Figure 18.7 mein hai. [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ ke paani ke ligands seedhe ammonia se bhi badle ja sakte hain; is mein chaar paani ke molecules ki jagah chaar NH₃ aate hain.
Aasani ke liye [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ ko aam tor par [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺ likha jata hai.

blocks.alt: Square brackets mein [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+: beech mein Cu, chaar NH3 aik dashed square plane ke konon par (aage ke do wedge bonds par, peechhe ke do dashed bonds par), aur aik H2O plane ke oopar aur aik neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.7: [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺(aq) ion ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 18.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaar NH₃ ek square plane mein (aage ke do wedge bonds par, peechhe ke do dashed bonds par) aur do H₂O is plane ke upar aur neeche hain; kul chhe ligands, is liye shakal octahedral hai.

Concentrated hydrochloric acid qatra qatra dalne se chloride ions bhi [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ ke paani ke ligands ki jagah le lete hain. Peela (yellow) solution banta hai jis mein complex ion [CuCl₄]²⁻ hota hai (Figure 18.8).

blocks.alt: Teen flasks. Beech wala ('Start here'): neela [Cu(H2O)6]2+, paani ke saath mashhoor neela Cu2+ complex. Baen, conc. HCl ki botal ke saath: peela-hara [CuCl4]2-, jo conc. HCl daalne se banta hai. Daen, conc. NH3 ki botal ke saath: gehra neela [Cu(H2O)2(NH3)4]2+, jo conc. NH3 daalne se banta hai. Flasks ke darmiyan equilibrium ke teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.8: Ligand exchange reaction ke natije mein rang ki tabdeeliyan (kitab ki Figure 18.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beech ke neele flask se shuru karein. Conc. HCl dalne se chaar Cl⁻ chhe H₂O ki jagah lete hain aur tetrahedral peela-sabz [CuCl₄]²⁻ banta hai; conc. NH₃ dalne se chaar NH₃ chaar H₂O ki jagah lete hain aur gehra neela octahedral complex banta hai. Teer dono taraf hain kyun ke yeh equilibrium hain: zyada paani dalne se reaction wapas jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.8 ki ibarat mein ‘This is yellow-green complex forms’ chhapa hai; durust angrezi ‘This yellow-green complex forms’ hai (yeh peela-sabz complex banta hai).

blocks.prompt: Copper(II) solution mein zyada ammonia dalne par gehra neela rang kaun sa complex ion deta hai?

items: [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ neela; OH⁻ se halka neela precipitate [Cu(H₂O)₄(OH)₂].
Conc. NH₃ se gehra neela [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺; conc. HCl se peela [CuCl₄]²⁻.
